scope: All 51 scientific reference identities; seven selected mechanism/correction references. Drug claims and product labels have a separate agent audit.
methodology: Compare normalized titles and case-insensitive DOI strings against original PubMed XML and Europe PMC core metadata.
Extract DOI only from PubmedData/ArticleIdList, not reference lists embedded in XML.
Attempt every actual PubMed HTML page and DOI landing page. HTTP success alone does not prove article access; redirect/interstitial pages do not count as content.
Distinguish correction/comment links from retractions. No indexed retraction is a bounded database finding, not a guarantee of research integrity.
Full text access does not imply independent replication; selected claims and boundary conditions are recorded separately.

mechanism_claim_audit.finding: Patient lines showed 2–6-fold lower full-length BubR1. I909T/L1012P were HSP90-dependent; forced expression at WT-comparable levels restored the nocodazole checkpoint response.
mechanism_claim_audit.boundary: Different variants and transformed/cultured cells. This does not establish N1002K instability, readthrough efficacy, or drug rescue. The 731X construct is not this case's exact Leu737Ter allele.

mechanism_claim_audit.finding: The abstract supports PLK1-dependent KARD phosphorylation, PP2A-B56 recruitment, opposition to Aurora B, and attachment stabilization.
mechanism_claim_audit.boundary: Publisher HTML/PDF were blocked; FULL API returned 401, public author-thesis fallback returned 403. Do not claim a new full-text/figure audit or exact residue-boundary verification from this paper.

mechanism_claim_audit.locator: Full primary article, Figures 3A–E and 4A–I; Results: equivalent kinetochore expression and pseudokinase phenotypes
mechanism_claim_audit.finding: Phosphosignals were normalized by total BubR1 and inducible constructs were titrated to equivalent kinetochore levels. Pseudokinase mutants still impaired KARD/B56 signaling, alignment and checkpoint silencing.
mechanism_claim_audit.boundary: Published article text was viewed at a CC-BY mirror; publisher API exposed metadata only. No N1002K experiment. Extra protein cannot be equated with useful rescue.

mechanism_claim_audit.locator: Introduction and Figure 1B caption; paragraphs 3, 6 and 7 in cached extraction
mechanism_claim_audit.finding: The 2026 paper and domain map are real. TPR 59–219, pseudokinase 766–1050, the listed KEN/ABBA/D motifs, minimal GLEBS 408–418, Bub1-binding 440–460 and LxxIxE 669–674 match the Pro map.
mechanism_claim_audit.boundary: Annotation boundaries are conventions. TPR/MCC experiments do not determine activity of the exact Leu737Ter fragment or N1002K.

mechanism_claim_audit.finding: The paper explicitly maps human L1012 to mouse L1002. Comparable low BubR1 abundance can have different tissue phenotypes and mTORC1 activation, supporting allele-specific interpretation.
mechanism_claim_audit.boundary: Mouse allele series, not this child's alleles or a rapalog treatment result. Human N1002→mouse N992 mapping remains an unreplicated Pro calculation. Apply R09's correction.

mechanism_claim_audit.locator: Corrigendum body, Figure 2E and corrected pHH3 Methods
mechanism_claim_audit.finding: A duplicated sample image for +/L1002P and +/− in Figure 2E was replaced; the pHH3 mitotic-index Methods description was corrected. The original online article was updated.
mechanism_claim_audit.boundary: Keep this reference as correction provenance. Do not count it as a second independent allele-series study.

mechanism_claim_audit.finding: High WT BubR1 transgene expression improved fidelity, tumor resistance, selected tissue outcomes and lifespan in mice. Moderate expression did not reproduce every benefit.
mechanism_claim_audit.boundary: Genetic WT overexpression is not mutant stabilization or a drug trial. It does not establish human benefit, N1002K rescue, or safety in a child with prior/occult cancer.

unreplicated_Pro_calculations: C1 101/103 Asn conservation and human N1002→mouse N992 mapping: accompanying alignment/scripts ZIP was unavailable.
C1 side-chain SASA near 16 A2: not replicated from Pro scripts. Existing independent whole-residue SASA 27.73 A2 is a different quantity and not a direct contradiction.
No claim of replicating any Pro C2/C3 analysis or exact-genotype drug efficacy from citation verification.
